narration: We start from a clean install of the app.
The second phone comes up on the same screen.
Signing up takes just a couple of fields.
On the second phone, a tap opens Settings in its own copy of the app.
A unique throwaway address keeps repeat runs from colliding.
Then a password. Raw coordinates are a last resort for fields with no stable label, like password boxes.
Scroll the form up so the sign-up button is reachable.
And we're in.
The dashboard confirms we're signed in.
Adding our first note.
Notes sync instantly across devices.
Pressing and holding a note opens its context menu.
Swiping the row reveals quick actions.
Drag it onto the trash target to delete it.
Or a double tap archives it instantly.
The screen itself swipes too, in any direction.
Going back keeps everything saved.
Leaving the app is no problem at all.
Reopen it, and we land exactly where we left off.

command:
# Host-side scripting: anything a normal script can do
echo "device: $DEMO_SERIAL"
echo "app: $DEMO_APP_ID"
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
narration: The demo can also run commands on the machine driving it.

then.narration: The script checked its own output before carrying on.

else.narration: Unexpected output, but the tour carries on regardless.
